# Priority Development

No organization-wide Priority object, field, API or version behavior was imported into v1.0.0 because the inspected repositories did not provide a reviewed canonical source. Treat such facts as project/version-specific until an RDP domain owner validates them.

For each change, record the Priority version/environment, touched interfaces or entities, permissions, inputs/outputs, failure behavior and rollback. Default discovery to source inspection and read-only evidence. Never infer production safety from a test environment.
